function.name: make_webapi_call
function.description: Executes a call to a specified Web API endpoint with given parameters and returns the response. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

endpoint.description: The URL of the Web API endpoint to be called.

method.description: The HTTP method to be used for the API call.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested or submitted.

params.description: Query parameters to be appended to the endpoint URL.

query.description: The search term for the query.

body.description: The JSON payload to be sent with POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.

data.description: The actual data to be sent in the request body.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for a server response before timing out. This is a float type value.

Here’s a quick guide to getting started when you’re looking for a three‑bedroom flat in Zürich: | What matters most | Where to look & How | |-------------------|---------------------| | **Budget** | Decide your maximum rent per month (including utilities). In Zürich, a 3‑BHK typically starts around CHF 2 500–CHF 3 000+ depending on location and amenities. | | **Neighborhoods** | • *Zürcher Oberland* – quieter suburbs
• *Oerlikon / Zollikon* – good transport links
• *Wipkingen / Seebach* – family friendly, close to parks
• *Sihlcity / Fluntern* – modern developments | | **Transport** | Check proximity to S-Bahn/Tram lines and bike lanes if commuting. Use Google Maps “public transit” feature to estimate travel time to work/school. | | **Amenities** | Look for buildings offering laundry rooms, storage lockers, elevator access, parking permits, and security systems. | | **Legalities** | - Rental contracts usually last 12 months.
- Security deposit ≈ 1–2 months’ rent.
- Verify tenant rights via Swiss rental law resources. | ### Popular Listing Platforms | Platform | Notes | |----------|-------| | **Homegate.ch** | Largest portal, filters by room count, price, district. | | **ImmoScout24.com** | Extensive database, includes new builds. | | **Newhome.ch** | Focuses on newer constructions and luxury rentals. | | **Flatfox.ch** | Good for short‑term leases and furnished options. | | **Facebook Marketplace + local groups** | Often early postings from private landlords. | #### Tips for Applying 1. **Prepare Documents Early:** ID/passport, proof of income (last 3 payslips), employment contract, reference letters. 2. **Act Fast:** Listings move quickly—have everything ready so you can submit an application immediately after viewing. 3. **Use a Real Estate Agent?** If you prefer professional assistance, agents charge a fee (~1 month’s rent) but they handle paperwork and negotiations. --- If you’d like more tailored recommendations—for example, specific districts within a certain price bracket—or guidance on negotiating lease terms, just let me know!
